businessRules.statement: Every pipe segment MUST originate at a regulator node.
Segment MAOP MUST be ≤ regulator outlet design pressure. Pressure log entries with kpa > MAOP trigger immediate audit.
Per service point, m³ readings MUST be non-decreasing in time.
leakClass derived: indoorOrConfined OR requiresEvacuation OR hazardToPersons → 1 (immediate); hazardToProperty → 2 (P30d); else 3 (P15m). class 1 triggers emergency notice.
Leak records are append-only. Repair completion updates restored_at via reportLeak with prior leakDid as supersedes.
